action.body: Urgent safety escalation: DL-023, receiving lane L3, visible leakage of unassessed contents. Movement has stopped and staff are keeping clear. Please take control and confirm isolation and the next handling step.

later_events.body: Safety incident SAFE-023 accepted. Authorised depot safety staff have isolated the affected area and parcel from normal operations. Specialist assessment is requested; no driver or customer handling is authorised. Contents and liability remain unassessed.
